description: This Java source file defines the SandboxingContextFactory class, which customizes the Rhino JavaScript ContextFactory to sandbox JavaScript execution by enforcing resource limits and handling execution time and stack depth constraints.

classes.name: SandboxingContextFactory
classes.description: A custom Rhino ContextFactory responsible for sandboxing JavaScript execution with resource limitations and runtime constraints.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Creates and configures a new sandboxed Rhino Context with specified execution constraints.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Overrides default feature support to enable certain JavaScript features in the sandbox.

methods.name: observeInstructionCount
methods.description: Monitors the execution instruction count and throws an error if maximum script execution time is exceeded.

methods.name: doTopCall
methods.description: Prepares the context for execution by noting start time, then calls the superclass method to execute the script.
